- Worker-to-API authorization remains shared-secret HMAC with worker ID, timestamp, nonce, exact HTTP method/path/body binding, and short-lived single-use owner approval.
- Live worker verification uses `qa_only` jobs with `RENDER_DEPLOY` approval to avoid source, GitHub, or production deployment mutation.
- Treasury and freeze reports distinguish source/test capability, live aggregate endpoint evidence, and unverified operational/tax-compliance claims.
- Do not claim accounting/reporting support as tax filing or legal compliance.
